ارتبطوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَبَطُوا (irtabaṭū) /ir.ta.ba.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# اُرْتُبِطُوا (urtubiṭū) /ur.tu.bi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# اِرْتَبِطُوا (irtabiṭū) /ir.ta.bi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
